sources.title: Price Paid Data
sources.verified_claim: Price Paid Data covers sales for value lodged for registration, excludes unlodged and non-value transactions, and can lag recent market activity; it is transaction evidence rather than a candidate valuation.

sources.title: UK House Price Index for May 2026
sources.verified_claim: The accredited May 2026 UK HPI reports average prices, price changes, sales volumes and buyer/property categories; aggregate index results do not establish a parcel-specific achievable price.

sources.title: UK House Price Index: data downloads May 2026
sources.verified_claim: HMLR publishes the May 2026 UK HPI underlying aggregate CSV data and revision tables; recent estimates remain subject to revision.

sources.title: Private rent and house prices, UK: July 2026
sources.verified_claim: ONS reports provisional May 2026 house prices and June 2026 rents, including London-level movements, and explicitly flags revision and data-quality caveats.

sources.title: About the UK House Price Index
sources.verified_claim: HMLR documents UK HPI scope, sources and exclusions; some transaction types are omitted from the HPI input data and the model is not an individual-property appraisal.

sources.title: Quality and methodology
sources.verified_claim: The UK HPI uses completed sales and has broad coverage, but recent months are provisional and revisions can be larger at lower geographies with fewer transactions.

sources.title: How to access HM Land Registry Price Paid Data
sources.verified_claim: HMLR lists excluded transaction categories and explains that Price Paid Data is updated when records change; the dataset is not a complete record of every transfer or current asking value.

sources.title: UK House Price Index: reports
sources.published_at: updated 2026-06-17; current collection includes May release
sources.verified_claim: The official collection maintains monthly UK HPI reports, revision information and release schedules; publication chronology is retained instead of treating future releases as already available.
